IEAGHG (Santos, S.) (2013). Overview of the Current State and Development of CO2 Capture Technologies in the Ironmaking Process. IEAGHG Report 2013/TR3, April 2013. IEA Greenhouse Gas R&D Programme, Cheltenham, UK.

Technical review (40 printed pages, 43 PDF pages; PDF page = printed page + 3). Locators are PRINTED page numbers ("Page N of 40"). Loaded: Table 1 (p.31) ULCOS CO2-removal options on TGR-BF top gas (electricity capture + compression, steam) reprinted from Carpenter 2012/Birat 2010; COURSE50 RN-1 amine regeneration energy and PSA capture rate; POSCO/RIST aqueous ammonia capture rate and steam; module capacities and coke rates for BF, Midrex, HYL, COREX, FINEX, HIsarna. NOT loaded: Table 1 printed total energy (inconsistent with its own electricity + steam; other-values); route energy intensities (Fig. 5) and CO2 per tcs (other-values); Figs 9, 24-26, 40 reprint IEAGHG 2013-04 (ieaghg_2013_003, held) and were not re-extracted. The report prints NO costs and no ULCORED or ULCOWIN energy or cost numbers: UKERC rows IS-IW5..IW8 and IS-IS1 that credit "IEAGHG 2000; IEAGHG 2013(b)" are not found in it. Trap: RIST steam printed as "~1.5 kg of steam/t CO2" (misprint for t); GJ figure used.
